polish.scam.footer.en: This prompt and these questions come from fixed rules and may ask too much or too little. They do not change the frozen kernel's rules or the signed card, do not cover paths that bypass this page, and do not judge whether the recipient is a scammer; whether to continue is your decision. Until both questions are answered and this check allows you to continue, this page will not request a new SMS verification, confirm an approval or submit this payment; it may pause the confirmation flow and so delay or avoid initiating the transaction.
polish.scam.footer.zh-CN: 以上提示与问题由固定规则生成，可能漏问或多问；它不修改冻结内核的规则与签名卡，不覆盖绕过本页面的路径，也不判断收款人是否为诈骗方；是否继续由您决定。在两题回答完整且这一步自查允许继续之前，本界面不会再发起新的短信验证、确认审批或付款提交；它可能暂停确认流程，从而推迟或避免交易发起。

polish.scam.judge_note.en: Display-layer gate: it reads only the canonical card, the trusted contact registry, the user's own words and the attachment count. Answers are kept only in the current product session, bound to the action instance, the card identity and an answering epoch; they never enter the canonical card, the signature payload or the audit chain. Once the gate is established for an action, the controller entry points refuse to request a new SMS verification, confirm an approval or submit a dispatch until both questions are answered and the gate allows it; a changed card, a changed context or an answer-again gesture invalidates the earlier answers and requires new ones. A challenge issued earlier is not voided by this gate and still expires on its original window; after that, cancel and start again. The fraud warning above says the warning itself does not block or delay anything; this gate may pause the confirmation flow and so delay or avoid initiating the transaction. The pause is a display-layer gesture, not the kernel cooling-off period or delayed credit on the roadmap. Added after F9 and not part of the F9 measurement; there is no evidence yet that it identifies scams or reduces losses.
polish.scam.judge_note.zh-CN: 展示层门控：只读规范卡、可信通讯录、用户原话与附件数量。回答仅保存在当前产品会话，按动作实例、卡片身份与作答代次绑定，不进入规范卡、签名载荷或审计链。门控一经建立，在两题回答完整且本门控允许继续之前，控制器入口拒绝发起新的短信验证、确认审批与提交派发；卡片变化、上下文变化或“重新作答”都使此前的回答失效、须重新作答。已签发的挑战不被本门控作废，仍按原有效期过期；过期后需取消重来。上方防骗提醒所说的“不会拦截、延迟”指提醒本身；本门控可能暂停确认流程，从而推迟或避免交易发起。暂停是展示层手势，不是路线图中的内核冷静期或延时到账。该功能在 F9 之后新增，未纳入 F9 测量，尚无诈骗识别或减少损失的效果证据。

polish.scam.phrase_gate.en: You mentioned {authority} and also {pressure}. Banks, the police and anti-fraud centres never ask you to move money to a “safe account”, and never freeze your account because you did not transfer. This payment was not created and nothing was executed. To check, hang up first, then call 96110 or the official number on the back of your card.
polish.scam.phrase_gate.zh-CN: 您这句话提到了「{authority}」，还提到了「{pressure}」。银行、公安和反诈中心不会让您向“安全账户”转账，也不会因为您不转账就冻结账户。这笔付款没有生成，也没有执行任何操作。如需核实，请先挂断对方电话，拨打 96110 或银行卡背面的官方客服电话。

polish.scam.phrase_gate_judge.en: Phrase gate (fixed product-layer word lists): when the words of a payment or purchase request hit both closed lists, an impersonated authority (anti-fraud centre, police, prosecutor, court and the like) and a freeze / safe-account / transfer-now demand, the lexical router stops that sentence at clarification before the planner: the gate itself creates no draft and no card, dispatches nothing, and neither interrupts running plans nor withdraws pending cards. It applies only in this interface's chat and may hold a legitimate payment for one more step; it does not change the frozen kernel's rules or signed cards, does not cover paths that bypass the chat, and does not decide whether anyone is a fraudster: fixed lists miss some wording (paraphrases, typos, wording split over two turns) and also hold some legitimate wording. It was added after F9, is not part of the F9 measurement, and there is no evidence yet that it identifies fraud or reduces losses.
polish.scam.phrase_gate_judge.zh-CN: 话术闸门（产品层固定词表）：付款或申购请求的原话同时命中“冒充权威”（反诈中心、公安、公检法、检察院、法院等）与“冻结 / 安全账户 / 立即转账”两组封闭词表时，词法路由在规划器之前把这句停在澄清：闸门本身不建草稿、不出卡、派发为 0，也不中断进行中的计划、不撤回待确认的卡片。它只在本界面的对话里生效，可能让合法付款多停一步；它不修改冻结内核的规则与签名卡，不覆盖绕过对话的路径，也不判断对方是否为诈骗方：固定词表会漏判（改写、错别字、分两轮说的话），也会误伤合法说法。该功能在 F9 之后新增，未纳入 F9 测量，尚无诈骗识别或减少损失的效果证据。

polish.scam.opening.en: Please don't rush this payment. Your message mentions {cues}. Banks, the police and anti-fraud centres never ask you to move money to a “safe account”, and never freeze your account because you did not transfer. The payment below has not been executed; answer the two self-check questions before you continue. To check, hang up first, then call 96110 or the official number on the back of your card.
polish.scam.opening.zh-CN: 先别急着付款。您这句话里有这样的说法：{cues}。银行、公安和反诈中心不会让您向“安全账户”转账，也不会因为您不转账就冻结账户。下面这笔付款还没有执行，继续之前请先回答两个自查问题。如需核实，请先挂断对方电话，拨打 96110 或银行卡背面的官方客服电话。

polish.scam.preset_judge.en: The second question was preset to “yes” from the user's words (someone told them to pay, a closed rule); only the user's own answer-again gesture clears it, and the user's own answers decide from then on.
polish.scam.preset_judge.zh-CN: 第二题按原话预置为“是”（原话含“某某让我转”一类说法，封闭规则）；只有用户点「重新作答」才会清除，之后按用户自己的回答判定。
